name: Angelic Rose
original_name: アンジェリク・ローゼ
source:
Angelic Rose is a pure and innocent girl, who usually lives as a student. Everyone adores her like an idol. She has a strong sense of self-sacrifice, and she puts protecting others first.

Her weapon of choice is a wand. She is skilled in healing and recovery magic, and can use basic offensive magic (to the extent of tearing clothes and causing scratches).

[Translated from the [url=https://www.girls-software.com/witchhunter/index.html]official site[/url]]
